# Outlanders 2 Wiki

> An unofficial, evidence-backed reference for the city-builder Outlanders 2 by Pomelo Games: buildings, plants, resources, food, production chains, villager needs, campaigns, challenge levels, biomes and leaders. Values come from the game's own files (version 30, build 254) and are labelled when they have not been checked in play.

Every page is static HTML at a clean URL. Each article links to a "Sources & research" page with the evidence behind it, under https://outlanders2wiki.com/verification/.

## Campaigns

- [Campaign 1](https://outlanders2wiki.com/campaigns/campaign-1/): Campaigns contain stories of three levels focused on a leader or town. Story order below was observed in the game menu.
- [Campaign 2](https://outlanders2wiki.com/campaigns/campaign-2/): Campaigns contain stories of three levels focused on a leader or town. Story order below was observed in the game menu.
- [Campaign 3](https://outlanders2wiki.com/campaigns/campaign-3/): Campaigns contain stories of three levels focused on a leader or town. Story order below was observed in the game menu.

## Challenge types

- [Original challenges](https://outlanders2wiki.com/challenges/original/): A new, complete level, like the ones in the campaigns.
- [Redux challenges](https://outlanders2wiki.com/challenges/redux/): A simpler or different version of an earlier level.
- [Bounty challenges](https://outlanders2wiki.com/challenges/bounty/): Make or hold as much of one resource as you can before time runs out.
- [Chill challenges](https://outlanders2wiki.com/challenges/chill/): An older challenge type, still playable from the archive. Some have a day limit, as Town of the Year does.
- [Ranked challenges](https://outlanders2wiki.com/challenges/ranked/): An older challenge type scored on a leaderboard, still playable from the archive. The game files call it Leaderboard.
- [Remix challenges](https://outlanders2wiki.com/challenges/remix/): An older challenge type, still playable from the archive. Going by their file names, several are reworked campaign levels.

## Leaders

- [Pablo](https://outlanders2wiki.com/heroes/pablo/): Knows everything there is to know about the Outlands. Except where it ends.
- [Miranda](https://outlanders2wiki.com/heroes/miranda/): Keeps a low profile, yet her inner life is full of undiscovered talents.
- [Edgar](https://outlanders2wiki.com/heroes/edgar/): A sweet, intuitive leader who tends to be his own worst enemy.
- [Maddy](https://outlanders2wiki.com/heroes/maddy/): Sweet lady, though a little overbearing and sometimes a bit too power-hungry.
- [Felix](https://outlanders2wiki.com/heroes/felix/): Occasionally forgetful, especially about the number of glasses of wine he's had.
- [Jaqweshia](https://outlanders2wiki.com/heroes/jaqweshia/): Her multitasking skills are only hindered by the constant feeling of not doing enough.
- [Jelena](https://outlanders2wiki.com/heroes/jelena/): Once she sets her mind on something, she doesn't stop (unless she sets her mind on stopping).
- [Cory](https://outlanders2wiki.com/heroes/cory/): Struggles to keep a cool head. So they take turns.
- [Kaia](https://outlanders2wiki.com/heroes/kaia/): Her dreams of underwater worlds feel like memories.
- [Chico](https://outlanders2wiki.com/heroes/chico/): On a quest to fulfill his wish, whatever it may be.
- [Izzy](https://outlanders2wiki.com/heroes/izzy/): Thinks volume knobs are for cowards.
- [Maira](https://outlanders2wiki.com/heroes/maira/): Has a lifetime stock of black nail polish.
- [Fjordi](https://outlanders2wiki.com/heroes/fjordi/): Hates being the center of attention, but somehow always is.
